scope: Acceptance of known omission fixes and operational safeguards, not a promise of permanent upstream or GitHub availability.

live_acceptance.note: 69 byte-verified files include 68 current official entries and a supplemental mirror discovery. This does not convert a mirror-only metadata exception into an official current-version confirmation.

operational_controls.alert_issue: Created or updated only on actual unhealthy findings; recovered findings close the marked issue.
operational_controls.external_monitor: Separate ChatGPT condition watch enabled every six hours; normal results are silent.

verification_limits: The end-to-end refresh and health read/commit paths were exercised live. Failure decision, cooldown, watermark and catchup branches were tested offline; no synthetic incident was sent to the owner.
No future scheduled run can be proven before its scheduled time. Hourly internal and six-hour external checks detect failures or missed schedules.
GitHub may delay/drop scheduled jobs; upstream APIs may limit access or change schemas. A personal CONGRESS_API_KEY remains recommended.
Unpublished or not-yet-indexed material, supplemental current-version metadata exceptions, and optional historical backlog are outside the current official completeness claim.
